sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head broadly oval, only slightly longer than wide, the maximum width in the posterior third, sides convex, posterior margin rounded; fontanelle opening small (0.13 mm), with a chitinous ring and not projecting; antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 and segment 3 equal in length, segments 3 and 4 nearly equal; mandibles short, distinctly incurved, about as long as half the head width or slightly longer; pronotum much narrower than the head, about 3/4 of the head width.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown; labrum, antennae, pronotum and legs paler than the head. Head with a few erect hairs, thorax sparsely hairy, abdomen densely hairy. Head broadly oval, weakly narrowed anteriorly, slightly longer than wide, the maximum width in the posterior third, sides convex, posterior margin rounded; fontanelle opening small (0.13 mm), with a chitinous ring, not projecting; eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 and segment 3 equal in length, segments 3 and 4 nearly equal; labrum as long as wide, with a short transparent part at the tip. Mandibles short, distinctly incurved, the tips pointed, about as long as or slightly longer than half the head width; the inner margin of the left mandible smooth in the distal two thirds, with a broad basal tooth and 2 serrations that increase in size from the proximal to the distal end in the proximal third; the serrations of the proximal third of the right mandible very indistinct. Postmentum rod-like, widest in the anterior third, the narrowest point well below the midpoint. Pronotum much narrower than the head width (about 3/4 of the head width), its length almost half its width, anterior margin weakly concave with a weak median notch, posterior margin weakly concave, margins and disc with a few short and long hairs. Measurements (mm): head length to the lateral base of the mandible 1.24—1.31; maximum head width 1.07—1.13; anterior head width 0.65; head contraction index 0.59; head index 0.86; labrum length 0.28, width 0.28; head—mandible index 0.58; pronotum length 0.27—0.29, width 0.77—0.81; pronotum index 0.48; pronotum/head width index 0.72; antennae 14-segmented.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate unknown. In Table 15 the mandible length, postmentum length and postmentum width rows of this species are missing in the extracted text and are not recorded.
